subject: spanish
source_note: Topic structure follows the Cambridge IGCSE IGCSE Spanish specification. Connections, sequence and prerequisites are expert-authored teaching relationships (exam boards do not publish these).

connections.why: Daily routines naturally extend into home, family and social life
Personal life is set within the local area, environment and wider world
Local environment and travel broaden into global and international issues
Education and personal goals lead into careers and the world of work
Work and careers increasingly operate in an international, global context
Everyday activities like shopping and travel are framed by the surrounding world
Listening and reading are the receptive skills, both assessed across all topic areas
Speaking and writing are the productive skills that reuse topic-area vocabulary
The first topic area provides core vocabulary practised in listening tasks
Personal and social topics are the staple of speaking-exam role-plays and conversation
World/environment topics are common reading-comprehension contexts
International and global topics make frequent extended-writing prompts
